title: Case 1 as a phone photo

document.howTo: Run build-documents.ts, print 02-phone-photo.print.pdf (case 1's page), photograph it at an angle with a shadow at about 12 MP, then shrink it as the app does before upload (prepare-quote-file.ts): longest edge 2048 px, JPEG at quality 85 (macOS: sips -Z 2048 -s format jpeg -s formatOptions 85 <photo> --out eval/quotes/documents/02-phone-photo.jpg).

pending.change: A8 case 3: the owner must set the rule; A8 proposes battery voltage on battery lines only. The inverter line writes 48 V.

notes: Expected exactly as case 1. Measures digit accuracy on photos.
source.page may be 1 or null on a photo, so it is recorded, not scored.
